scripts.title: Op tool kill all script
scripts.script:
-- Team-Aware Single-Tool Death-Resilient Auto-Click Suite
-- Compatible with Delta and universal executors

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local vim = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local player = players.LocalPlayer

local screenGui, mainFrame, statusLabel, playStopBtn, autoClickBtn, scrollTools, scrollHealth

local activeToolName = nil
local suiteActive = false
local autoClickActive = false
local currentTarget = nil

-- Function to check if a player is on your team
local function isEnemy(targetPlayer)
	if targetPlayer == player then return false end
	
	-- Check standard Roblox Team property
	if player.Team and targetPlayer.Team then
		if targetPlayer.Team == player.Team then
			return false -- Same team, do not attack!
		end
	end
	
	-- Check for Team/Faction attributes or group configs commonly used in games
	if player:GetAttribute("Team") and targetPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") then
		if player:GetAttribute("Team") == targetPlayer:GetAttribute("Team") then
			return false
		end
	end
	
	return true -- Valid enemy
end

-- Function to recreate the UI cleanly on respawn
local function createUI()
	local existing = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TeamAwareKillSuiteGui")
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end

	screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screenGui.Name = "TeamAwareKillSuiteGui"
	screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screenGui.Parent = player.PlayerGui

	mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 480)
	mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 120)
	mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 15, 30)
	mainFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
	mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2
	mainFrame.Active = true
	mainFrame.Draggable = true
	mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

	local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
	titleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 25, 50)
	titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	titleLabel.TextSize = 11
	titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	titleLabel.Text = "TEAM-AWARE AUTO KILL"
	titleLabel.Parent = mainFrame

	statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20)
	statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 32)
	statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
	statusLabel.TextSize = 10
	statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansItalic
	statusLabel.Text = activeToolName and ("Active: " .. activeToolName) or "Select 1 tool, then press PLAY:"
	statusLabel.Parent = mainFrame

	playStopBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	playStopBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
	playStopBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 55)
	playStopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = suiteActive and Color3.fromRGB(20, 180, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)
	playStopBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	playStopBtn.TextSize = 12
	playStopBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	playStopBtn.Text = suiteActive and "STATUS: PLAYING (STOP)" or "STATUS: STOPPED (PLAY)"
	playStopBtn.Parent = mainFrame

	autoClickBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	autoClickBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28)
	autoClickBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 90)
	autoClickBtn.BackgroundColor3 = autoClickActive and Color3.fromRGB(20, 180, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)
	autoClickBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	autoClickBtn.TextSize = 11
	autoClickBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	autoClickBtn.Text = autoClickActive and "AUTO-CLICK: ON" or "AUTO-CLICK: OFF"
	autoClickBtn.Parent = mainFrame

	local toolListHeader = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	toolListHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 18)
	toolListHeader.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 122)
	toolListHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	toolListHeader.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	toolListHeader.TextSize = 10
	toolListHeader.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	toolListHeader.Text = "--- SELECT YOUR TOOL ---"
	toolListHeader.Parent = mainFrame

	scrollTools = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scrollTools.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 90)
	scrollTools.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 142)
	scrollTools.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 18)
	scrollTools.BorderSizePixel = 1
	scrollTools.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scrollTools.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scrollTools.Parent = mainFrame

	local toolListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	toolListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)
	toolListLayout.Parent = scrollTools

	local healthHeader = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	healthHeader.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 18)
	healthHeader.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 235)
	healthHeader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	healthHeader.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
	healthHeader.TextSize = 10
	healthHeader.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	healthHeader.Text = "--- LIVE ENEMY HEALTH HUD ---"
	healthHeader.Parent = mainFrame

	scrollHealth = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scrollHealth.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 195)
	scrollHealth.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 255)
	scrollHealth.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 18)
	scrollHealth.BorderSizePixel = 1
	scrollHealth.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scrollHealth.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scrollHealth.Parent = mainFrame

	local healthListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	healthListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 3)
	healthListLayout.Parent = scrollHealth

	playStopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if not activeToolName then
			statusLabel.Text = "Error: Select a tool first!"
			return
		end
		suiteActive = not suiteActive
		if suiteActive then
			playStopBtn.Text = "STATUS: PLAYING (STOP)"
			playStopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 180, 40)
		else
			playStopBtn.Text = "STATUS: STOPPED (PLAY)"
			playStopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)
			currentTarget = nil
			statusLabel.Text = "Status: Stopped"
		end
	end)

	autoClickBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		autoClickActive = not autoClickActive
		if autoClickActive then
			autoClickBtn.Text = "AUTO-CLICK: ON"
			autoClickBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 180, 40)
		else
			autoClickBtn.Text = "AUTO-CLICK: OFF"
			autoClickBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)
		end
	end)
end

local function updateToolList()
	if not scrollTools then return end
	for _, child in ipairs(scrollTools:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
	if not backpack then return end
	
	local foundTools = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(foundTools, item) end
	end
	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(foundTools, item) end
		end
	end
	
	for _, tool in ipairs(foundTools) do
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 26)
		
		local isSelected = (activeToolName == tool.Name)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = isSelected and Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 65)
		btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		btn.TextSize = 10
		btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
		btn.Text = (isSelected and "▶ " or "📦 ") .. tool.Name
		btn.Parent = scrollTools
		
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			activeToolName = tool.Name
			statusLabel.Text = "Active: " .. tool.Name
			
			for _, other in ipairs(scrollTools:GetChildren()) do
				if other:IsA("TextButton") then
					if other == btn then
						other.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 100)
						other.Text = "▶ " .. tool.Name
					else
						other.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 65)
						other.Text = "📦 " .. string.gsub(other.Text, "^[▶📦] ", "")
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function acquireNextTarget()
	if not suiteActive then return end
	for _, p in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
		if isEnemy(p) and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			local enemyHumanoid = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if enemyHumanoid and enemyHumanoid.Health > 0 then
				currentTarget = p
				statusLabel.Text = "Target: " .. p.Name
				return
			end
		end
	end
	currentTarget = nil
	statusLabel.Text = "No enemies left!"
end

-- Respawn auto-recovery
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
	currentTarget = nil
	task.wait(0.6)
	createUI()
	
	local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
	backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(updateToolList)
	backpack.ChildRemoved:Connect(updateToolList)
	updateToolList()
end)

createUI()
local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(updateToolList)
backpack.ChildRemoved:Connect(updateToolList)
updateToolList()

-- Main Teleport & Auto-Click Loop with Team Filtering
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if scrollHealth and scrollHealth.Parent then
			for _, child in ipairs(scrollHealth:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("TextLabel") then child:Destroy() end
			end
			
			for _, p in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
				if p ~= player then
					local hpText = "Dead / Offline"
					local textColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
					
					if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						local hum = p.Character.Humanoid
						hpText = math.floor(hum.Health) .. " / " .. math.floor(hum.MaxHealth)
						if hum.Health > 0 then
							if isEnemy(p) then
								textColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50) -- Red for enemies
							else
								textColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255) -- Blue for teammates
							end
						else
							textColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
						end
					end
					
					local labelPrefix = isEnemy(p) and "⚔️ [Enemy] " or "🛡️ [Team] "
					local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
					lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 22)
					lbl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 18, 28)
					lbl.TextColor3 = textColor
					lbl.TextSize = 10
					lbl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
					lbl.Text = labelPrefix .. p.Name .. " | HP: " .. hpText
					lbl.Parent = scrollHealth
				end
			end
		end
		
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		
		if suiteActive and activeToolName and character and rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			-- Verify current target is still valid and an enemy
			if not currentTarget or not isEnemy(currentTarget) or not currentTarget.Character or not currentTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				acquireNextTarget()
			else
				local enemyRoot = currentTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local enemyHumanoid = currentTarget.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				
				if not enemyHumanoid or enemyHumanoid.Health <= 0 or not enemyRoot then
					acquireNextTarget()
				else
					pcall(function()
						-- Teleport to enemy
						rootPart.CFrame = enemyRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.5)
						
						local tool = backpack:FindFirstChild(activeToolName) or character:FindFirstChild(activeToolName)
						if tool then
							if tool.Parent ~= character then
								humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
							end
							
							if autoClickActive then
								tool.Parent = character
								
								-- Virtual input click
								vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, true, game, 0)
								task.wait(0.01)
								vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(0, 0, 0, false, game, 0)
								
								if tool:FindFirstChild("Activate") then
									tool:Activate()
								end
								
								-- Fire any remote events found inside the tool
								for _, desc in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
									if desc:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
										desc:FireServer(enemyRoot.Position)
									elseif desc:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
										pcall(function() desc:InvokeServer(enemyRoot.Position) end)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)

-- إنشاء الأقسام

    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

        btn.Text = "تم حفظ التشيك بوينت!"

        btn.Text = "حفظ التشيك بوينت الحالي"

        LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = SavedCheckpoint
    end
end)

CreateButton(TabTeleport, "أداة الانتقال الفوري (Click TP)", function()
    local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "Zoro Teleport"
    tool.RequiresHandle = false
    tool.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
    
    tool.Activated:Connect(function()

    end

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if InfJumpEnabled and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState("Jumping")
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.WalkSpeed = CustomSpeed
            hum.JumpPower = CustomJump
        end
        
        if NoclipEnabled then
            for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end
end)
